reviews.review_msg: Good instructor and a good person. The lectures were very structured, and the slides were clear. Provides practice questions for every lecture and provides mock midterms and finals. I only used his slides, and I did really well. Do the questions by HAND (no matter how simple it looks). Understand terms for example value of equity vs cost of equity.
After taken his 312, I chose 313 with him. He is so knowledgeable and cares about his students

He had no idea what he was teaching. The corporate finance course is supposed to be taught by someone who knows finance. In the first midterm someone said the formula for covariance is wrong on the formula sheet he offered, and he had to check ChatGPT to see if the formula is correct! This was not the only time he did not know basic material.
Great prof. cares for his students, always available to help and answers emails quickly
